perks.description: After hiding for 15s within 24m of the Killer, while in their Terror Radius, you earn 1 Token, up to 4. While you have at least 1 Token, basic Skill Checks are replaced by special Skill Checks. Special Skill Checks grant +4% more progress. Whenever you hit or miss a special Skill Check, spend 1 Token.

perks.name: Starstruck
perks.description: While carrying a Survivor, Survivors within your Terror Radius gain. This ends 30s after: They leave your Terror Radius.. You drop or Hook the carried Survivor.. Cooldown: 60s.

perks.name: Still Sight
perks.description: After being idle for 2s, within 24m, until you start moving: You see the Killer's Aura.. You see the Auras of Chests.. You see the Auras of Generators..

perks.name: Streetwise
perks.description: The first time you deplete an item's Charges, you see the Killer's Aura for 8s. Whenever you loot an item from a Chest, it has 80% more Charges.

perks.name: Strength in Shadows
perks.description: While in the Basement: You can heal yourself, but 30% slower.. Whenever you finish healing, you see the Killer's Aura for 10s..

perks.name: Stridor
perks.description: Survivors' breathing noises are 25% louder and their Grunts of Pain are 50% louder.

perks.name: Superior Anatomy
perks.description: Whenever a Survivor medium or fast-vaults within 12m of you, the next time you basic-vault a Window, you basic-vault Windows 40% faster for 10s. Cooldown: 20s.

perks.name: Surge
perks.description: Whenever you down a Survivor with a basic-attack, Generators within 32m: Explode, lose 8% progress and start regressing.. Survivor repairing them scream..

perks.name: Surveillance
perks.description: You see the Auras of regressing Generators. Whenever a Generator stops regressing, you see its Aura for 16s. Generator repair noises can be heard from 8m farther away.

perks.name: Teamwork: Collective Stealth
perks.description: Whenever another Survivor finishes healing you, while within 16m of each other, you both leave no Scratch Marks. When either of you leaves the range, this ends after 4s.

perks.name: Teamwork: Full Circuit
perks.description: For each other Survivor repairing a Generator with you, good basic Skill Check zones are 25% bigger. While repairing with at least 1 other Survivor, you repair 5% faster.

perks.name: Teamwork: Power of Two
perks.description: Whenever you finish healing another Survivor, while you stay within 16m of each other, you both gain 5%. When either of you leaves the range, this ends after 4s.

perks.name: Teamwork: Soft-Spoken
perks.description: For each other Survivor repairing a Generator with you, the range of Generator repair noises is 25% smaller. While repairing with at least 1 other Survivor, you repair 5% faster.

perks.name: Teamwork: Throw Down
perks.description: Whenever you blind or Pallet-stun the Killer, for 10s, other injured Survivors within 24m: Gain.. See the Killer's Aura..

perks.name: Teamwork: Toughen Up
perks.description: While injured, whenever another Survivor within 24m of you blinds or Pallet-stuns the Killer, for 30s: You make no Grunts of Pain.. You leave no Pools of Blood.. You leave no Scratch Marks..

perks.name: Technician
perks.description: While repairing a Generator: The range of Generator repair noises is 16m shorter.. Whenever you miss a basic Skill Check, the Generator does not explode, but loses 2% more progress..

perks.name: Tenacity
perks.description: While downed: You gain 50%.. You can crawl and recover at the same time.. Your Grunts of Pain are 75% quieter.. The Killer cannot see your Aura..

perks.name: Terminus
perks.description: When all Generators are completed: all injured, downed, and hooked Survivors gain. When an Exit Gate is opened, this ends after 45s.

perks.name: Territorial Imperative
perks.description: Whenever a Survivor enters the Basement while you are 24m away from it, you see their Aura for 6s. Cooldown: 45s.

perks.name: Thanatophobia
perks.description: For each injured, downed, or hooked Survivor, all Survivors: Cleanse Totems 2% slower.. Repair 2% slower.. Sabotage Hooks 2% slower.. While 4 Survivors are either injured, downed or hooked, all above actions are additionally 12% slower.

perks.name: This Is Not Happening
perks.description: Good basic Skill Check zones are 200% bigger.

perks.name: Thrilling Tremors
perks.description: Whenever you pick-up a Survivor, all Generators not being repaired are blocked for 16s. Cooldown: 30s.

perks.name: THWACK!
perks.description: When the trial starts, you earn 3 Tokens, up to 3. Whenever you hook a Survivor, you earn 1 Token. Whenever you break a Pallet or Breakable Wall, spend 1 Token. Then, all Survivors within 36m scream and you see their Auras for 6s.

perks.name: Tinkerer
perks.description: The first time each Generator has 70% progress: You gain for 16s.. You are alerted..

perks.name: Trail of Torment
perks.description: Whenever you damage a Generator, until it stops regressing: You gain.. Survivors see that Generator's Aura.. Cooldown: 30s.

perks.name: Troubleshooter
perks.description: While chased by the Killer: You see the Aura of the Generator with the most progress.. Whenever you drop a Pallet, you see the Killer's Aura for 6s.. When the Killer stops chasing you, this ends after 10s.

perks.name: Turn Back The Clock
perks.description: After hooking a Survivor, for the next 60s, use to make target Generator you can see within 20m explode, lose 10% progress and start regressing.

perks.name: Ultimate Weapon
perks.description: Whenever you search a Locker, Survivors within 40m: Gain for 30s.. Scream.. Cooldown: 45s.

perks.name: Unbound
perks.description: Whenever a healthy Survivor becomes injured, for the next 30s, whenever you basic-vault a window, gain 5% for 25s.

perks.name: Unbreakable
perks.description: Once per trial, while downed by the Killer, you can fully recover. While downed, you recover 35% faster.

perks.name: Undone
perks.description: Whenever you hook a Survivor, earn 1 Token, up to 3. Whenever you damage a Generator, spend all Tokens. For each Token spent: The Generator loses 10% more progress.. The Generator is blocked for 10s..

perks.name: Unforeseen
perks.description: Whenever you damage a Generator: Your Terror Radius is set to that Generator for 30s and its radius is 32m.. You gain for that time.. Cooldown: 30s.

perks.name: Unnerving Presence
perks.description: Survivors within your Terror Radius get 10% more basic Skill Checks. The good zone of basic Skill Checks is 60% smaller.

perks.name: Unrelenting
perks.description: Your missed basic-attack cooldown is 40% shorter. Your successful basic-attack cooldown is 10% shorter.

perks.name: Up the Ante
perks.description: For each other Survivor alive, all Survivors are 3% luckier. All Survivors can attempt to unhook themselves.

perks.name: Urban Evasion
perks.description: While crouched, you gain 100%.

perks.name: Vigil
perks.description: All Survivors within 16m of you lose 30% faster. This effect ends 15s after they leave your range.

perks.name: Visionary
perks.description: Within 32m of you, you see the Auras of Generators. Whenever a Generator is completed, cooldown: 16s.

perks.name: Wake Up!
perks.description: When all Generators are completed: You see the Auras of Exit Gate Switches.. While opening an Exit Gate, other Survivors see your Aura.. You open Exit Gates 10% faster, and an additional 20% faster for each other Survivor alive..

perks.name: Wandering Eye
perks.description: Whenever you start chasing a Survivor, for the next 5s, you see the Auras of all other injured Survivors within 20m. Cooldown: 30s.

perks.name: We See You
perks.description: Whenever the Killer sees your Aura, you earn 1 Token. Cooldown: 10s. When you have 4 Tokens, spend them all. Then, all Survivors see the Killer's Aura for 15s.

perks.name: We'll make it
perks.description: Whenever you unhook a Survivor, for 90s, you heal other Survivors 100% faster.

perks.name: We're Gonna Live Forever
perks.description: You heal downed Survivors 100% faster. Whenever you finish healing a downed Survivor, they gain for 10s. Cooldown: 30s.

perks.name: Weave Attunement
perks.description: The first time each item is depleted, it is dropped. While a Survivor is within 12m of a dropped item: You see their Aura.. They see the item's Aura.. Whenever a Survivor picks-up an item, they gain for 30s.

perks.name: Whispers
perks.description: While within 24m of a Survivor, you randomly hear whispers. While more than 24m away from a Survivor, gain 5%.

perks.name: Wicked
perks.description: While in the Basement, you can unhook yourself. Whenever you are unhooked, you see the Killer's Aura for 20s.

perks.name: Wide Open Throttle
perks.description: Whenever you fast-vault a Pallet: You gain 15% for 3s.. The Pallet is reset, blocked for 60s, and all Survivors see its Aura for that time.. Cooldown: 60s.

perks.name: Windows of Opportunity
perks.description: Within 24m of you see the Auras of Windows. You vault Windows % faster. Whenever you vault a Window, cooldown: 30s.

perks.name: Wiretap
perks.description: After repairing 40% of Generators, while next to a Generator, use to trap it for 120s or until the Killer damages that Generator. All Survivors see that Generator's Aura for that time. While the Killer is within 14m of that Generator, all Survivors see the Killer's Aura.

perks.name: Zanshin Tactics
perks.description: Within 32m, you see the Auras of Pallets and windows. Whenever a Survivor drops a Pallet, you see their Aura for 5s.
